policy: Advisory relevance is not a claim the repository uses a vulnerable version. CVE ranges require exact dependency/product version matching.

advisories.title: Indirect Prompt Injection
advisories.required_conditions: LLM consumes adversarial issue, code, document or tool response and treats it as authorization
advisories.observed: Repository/host workflows read external content; source rules treat data as untrusted
advisories.not_verified: Installed v0.0.2 behavior; whether content can cause unauthorized actions
advisories.decision: Carry as attack-path intelligence, not CVE

advisories.title: AI-Enabled Exfiltration
advisories.required_conditions: Connected AI host with access to protected data and an exfiltration-capable tool
advisories.observed: Host-dependent tool use is part of product design, not an assured runtime capability
advisories.not_verified: Real host permissions or any exfiltration attempts
advisories.decision: Monitor tool grants and defend data flows; not a product-specific CVE

advisories.identifier: GitHub Actions self-hosted runner minimum version enforcement 2026
advisories.title: Runner update/deprecation enforcement
advisories.required_conditions: Owner-managed self-hosted runner with outdated agent binary/version
advisories.observed: Current repository integrates self-hosted runner-based development CI; binary versions not retrieved
advisories.not_verified: Actual runner software versions or whether enforcement affects this installation
advisories.decision: Green can check runner versions via approved official read-only surfaces; never runtime dependency
